title: Every list page keeps its own search box (Parts, Reports, detail tabs)
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the page being searched.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The page-search rollout has shipped (same programme as the Work Orders filters).
steps: 1. Visit several list surfaces: a Parts view (for example Inventory), a report, a customer's Notes tab on the customer page, and any pop-up list that used to be searchable.
2. On each, look for that surface's own search box and use it.
expected: 1. Every list surface that could be text-searched before still offers its own search control - no list silently lost its search.
2. Each search box narrows only its own list, not any other page.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); tech plan 2026-07-29 Phase 9.1 (built-in table search, opt-out); spec v1.3 S13-R22 + S14-R5/R6 (export awaited)
notes: Tech plan 2026-07-29 (engineering intent - confirm live at the wording/behaviour pass): engineering's safety net is a built-in search on every list table (opt-out) precisely so nothing is forgotten - this case is the release sweep for it. Pull the exact page list (S13-R22) from the spec v1.3 export when it arrives.
